Not pundit analysis, but the thoughts of Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor to Sky Sports ahead of the new WSL season. And despite the hint of cliché, it works. There has been plenty upheaval over the last two years, starting with Bompastor replacing Emma Hayes. Then, there was the shock departure of Paul Green as head of women's football in February. messages.text: Serena and Venus Williams suffer agonising US Open doubles defeat

metadata.summary: Serena and Venus Williams turn back the clock to defeat Maya Joint and Chan Hao-Ching in a US Open women's doubles first-round epic.
metadata.content: US Open: Serena and Venus Williams suffer agonising defeat to Maya Joint and Chan Hao-Ching in a women's doubles first-round epic | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open: Serena and Venus Williams suffer agonising defeat to Maya Joint and Chan Hao-Ching in a women's doubles first-round epic Serena and Venus Williams suffer agonising defeat to Maya Joint and Chan Hao-Ching in a 10-point match tie-breaker at Flushing Meadows; watch the US Open live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app By Raz Mirza at Flushing Meadows, New York Saturday 5 September 2026 07:11, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of Serena Williams and Venus Williams against Maya Joint and Chan Hao-Ching in the US Open Serena and Venus Williams turn back the clock to defeat Maya Joint and Chan Hao-Ching in a US Open women's doubles first-round epic. In a fight to the finish, the Williams sisters rallied to force a third set tie-breaker in which they blew a 5-0 lead before falling to Joint and Chan 6-3 6-7 (8-6) 7-6 (10-7) in three hours and two minutes. The legendary sister act were playing their first Grand Slam together since the 2022 US Open, and 27 years after they first won the title. metadata.summary: Defending champion Thriston Lawrence reeled off six birdies in a row and then made an excellent par save from a bunker to secure the lead at the halfway stage of the Omega European Masters as he looks to emulate the late, great Seve Ballesteros.
metadata.content: DP World Tour Golf: Thriston Lawrence leads at halfway stage of Omega European Masters as he aims to emulate Seve Ballesteros | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content DP World Tour Golf: Thriston Lawrence leads at halfway stage of Omega European Masters as he aims to emulate Seve Ballesteros England's Harry Hall marches up leaderboard before injury sees him bogey three of his final five holes; Hall's countryman Paul Casey four shots behind Thriston Lawrence, who is looking to equal Seve Ballesteros by winning this event for third time since it joined DP World Tour schedule Friday 4 September 2026 23:49, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Leader Thriston Lawrence saved par at the fifth during the Omega European Masters on Friday when he chipped in from the sand - his second attempt to get out of that bunker! Defending champion Thriston Lawrence reeled off six birdies in a row and then made an excellent par save from a bunker to secure the lead at the halfway stage of the Omega European Masters as he looks to emulate the late, great Seve Ballesteros. Ballesteros is the only player to win this event three times since it became a DP World Tour tournament in 1972, doing so in 1977, 1978 and 1989 - but Lawrence has a chance to do likewise having triumphed at Crans-sur-Siere in 2022 and then again last season. Lewis Hamilton is predicting a “very close” battle in Italian Grand Prix qualifying on Saturday for what he says would he says would be a “dream” pole position at Monza. Hamilton was outperformed by his Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc in both of Friday's practice sessions but the team's overall performance, following the arrival of a new engine upgrade, suggested they have the pace to compete for pole. Leclerc topped Hamilton in first practice before Mercedes' George Russell was fastest in the second session, with Leclerc second and Hamilton only fifth behind Kimi Antonelli and McLaren's Lando Norris.
